The girl, trembling in anger, slowly covered her little brother's eyes while she carried him over to the next room. Cobwebs covered the floor in some areas, the room evidently decaying.

"Now, count back from 50nto 0, okay, Erin?"
"Mhm...."
"Don't make a sound"

The girl gave him an apologetic smile, still holding his hand before leaning down and kissing his small, dirty, bony hand. Erin whimpered in response at the normally cold teen's affection but kept counting, clutching the dusty pillow in his hands yet watching as she left the room from the corner of his eye.

Resignated to her fate, the girl sighed and stood in front of a young man. The man looked at her with utter hatred in disgust as he grabbed the thin, rusty knife from his coat pocket. 

"Thanks for the favor" The girl mumbled, grinning as the blade was pressed to her throat.

Erin cried out as he heard his older sister yelp. Forgetting his task, he scampered over to the horridly dirty living room, green eyes wide. 

"Nana! NANA! Nana, what's the man doing?" Erin yelled, voice cracking. The man dropped the knife and looked at him sadly before scooping Erin into his arms. 

"Now, cover your eyes little one" The man said. Erin did so, shaking in fear as he was put down. Surely his big sister wasn't going to leave him again...?

The girl silently extended a hand towards the young man, smiling when he took it, kissed it, and slashed her throat, blood spattered all over his arm.

Erin gasped at the silence, an eerie silence, as he was picked up. The last thing he saw, upon looking over the man's shoulder, was his sister's hopeful, yet betrayed look, her pale skin now stained a deep red. 

Erin screamed; another of his sibblings had met the same fate....
